stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Selenskyj wirft Trump wegen Diesel-Deal mit Putin Schwäche vor

en.title: War against Ukraine: Zelenskyy accuses Trump of weakness over diesel deal with Putin
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy views planned Russian diesel supplies to the United States as a gift to Putin. Ukraine reports damage to its power grid.

en.title: Trump diplomacy: diesel deal with Putin
en.summary: The US President secures Russian fuel for his core voters. The Ukrainian President is deeply angered.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Katie Zacharia wird neue Sprecherin des Weißen Hauses

en.title: Donald Trump: Katie Zacharia becomes new White House spokesperson
en.summary: Former television commentator Katie Zacharia will serve as spokesperson for Donald Trump. The conservative lawyer is considered a loyal supporter who previously worked for him.

stories.title: Werder Bremen - Niclas Füllkrug schockt Borussia Dortmund in der Nachspielzeit

en.title: Werder Bremen - Niclas Füllkrug shocks Borussia Dortmund in injury time
en.summary: Dortmund suffers its first points loss after four consecutive victories in the opening four matches. Former Borussia player Niclas Füllkrug is responsible for the result.

stories.title: Trump, Putin agree on deal to release Russian diesel to US, world markets

en.title: Trump, Putin agree on deal to release Russian diesel to US, world markets
en.summary: Donald Trump announced that Russia will supply diesel to global markets to help lower prices. The agreement represents a reversal of economic pressure on Russia since its invasion of Ukraine.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: Trump kündigt große Diesellieferungen aus Russland an

en.title: News blog on Ukraine war: Trump announces major diesel deliveries from Russia
en.summary: Trump stated he agreed with Putin to immediately supply over 300,000 tonnes of diesel for the US and world markets, with sanctions being relaxed in exchange.

stories.title: US-Handelsbeziehungen: Trump kündigt große Diesellieferungen aus Russland an

en.title: US trade relations: Trump announces major diesel deliveries from Russia
en.summary: Trump has reportedly agreed with Putin on large quantities of diesel deliveries from Russia, with his Treasury Department granting temporary authorization for the arrangement.

stories.title: Telefonat mit Wladimir Putin: Donald Trump kündigt große Diesellieferungen aus Russland an

en.title: Telephone call with Vladimir Putin: Donald Trump announces major diesel deliveries from Russia
en.summary: Following his conversation with Putin, Trump announced hundreds of thousands of tonnes of diesel from Russia would become available, with the US Treasury Department issuing temporary permission due to existing sanctions.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Trump: Habe mit Putin russische Diesel-Lieferung für USA und Weltmarkt vereinbart

en.title: USA under Trump: Trump says he agreed with Putin on Russian diesel supply for USA and world market
en.summary: Trump claims to have reached an agreement with Putin regarding Russian diesel deliveries to the United States and global markets.

en.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack according to investigators
en.summary: Investigators determined that the co-pilot of a Flydubai aircraft planned to crash it into an Israeli airport terminal in a late September incident.

stories.title: IStGH: Deutschland und weitere Staaten kritisieren US-Sanktionen gegen Strafgerichtshof

en.title: ICC: Germany and other countries criticize US sanctions against international court
en.summary: Germany and seven other nations oppose US plans to restrict the International Criminal Court's ability to operate, announced shortly after the court received the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: Völkerrecht: USA verhängen Sanktionen gegen Internationalen Strafgerichtshof

en.title: International Law: USA Imposes Sanctions Against International Criminal Court
en.summary: Foreign Minister Marco Rubio instructed court employees to cease work immediately, while the court expressed outrage and committed to continuing its investigations.

stories.title: US-Börsen: Techwerte erholen sich nach neuer KI-Angst – Wall Street schließt im Plus

en.title: US stocks: Tech shares recover from fresh AI concerns – Wall Street closes in the black
en.summary: Technology stocks rebounded as low expectations for further US military action against Iran eased oil market concerns and media reports reassured investors worried about an AI bubble.

stories.title: USA: Trump verkündet Diesel-Deal mit Kreml-Chef Putin

en.title: USA: Trump announces diesel deal with Kremlin chief Putin
en.summary: President Trump stated that Russia should bring over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to American and global markets. Ukraine responded with sharp criticism.

stories.title: USA: Katie Zacharia wird neue Trump-Sprecherin im Weißen Haus

en.title: USA: Katie Zacharia becomes new Trump spokeswoman in the White House
en.summary: The White House appointed Katie Zacharia as spokesperson, succeeding Karoline Leavitt. She comes from Trump's media operations.

stories.title: Panama: Schweres Erdbeben der Stärke 8 erschüttert Panama – Tsunami-Warnung

en.title: Panama: Severe earthquake of magnitude 8 shakes Panama – tsunami warning
en.summary: A severe magnitude 8 earthquake struck Panama. The U.S. tsunami warning center indicated the possibility of dangerous tidal waves.

stories.title: Essay: Mit dem Mut des Verzweifelten – Wie der Kanzler sich noch um dieses Land verdient machen will

en.title: Essay: With the courage of desperation – How the chancellor still wants to serve this country
en.summary: An essay examines Chancellor Friedrich Merz's tenure as potentially a historical misunderstanding, noting he has little left to lose but something to gain.
